note: Capture-time resample of take/sidecar_v1.jsonl (docs/takes-jsonl.md). Float64 reference, outputs rounded to binary32; compare p and q to the tolerance as given (the shortest-arc rule fixes the sign of q; the input has a pose stored as -q). Poses are ordered by (seg, cap) and a duplicated (seg, seq) keeps its first arrival. Frame f is shown at device time t_dev_ns; sources: exact, interp, held_gap, limited, before_first. trk is the state that caused a limited hold, else 5.
